expect railwayConfigFile to be root-directory-relative — it resolves from the REPO ROOT

deploy._lesson: Deploying CODE and applying CONFIG are separate acts. brand_config is a DB row; the seed JSON is only its reviewed source. Seed-on-boot (D-08) closes this, but only for rows carrying a _seeded_from stamp.
deploy.vercel: github-connected 2026-08-06: Korona7x17/brandcortex, prodBranch main, root apps/web. Pushes deploy. Before this it was CLI-upload-only, and `vercel deploy` stamps the local branch onto an upload — the dashboard shows that identically to a real integration, so check `link` via the REST API, never the deployment meta.
deploy.railway: FIXED 2026-08-07 — deploys on push to main. It was never disconnected: every push built at the REPO ROOT and failed (Railpack found no app), while the old container kept serving. rootDirectory=apps/api, dockerfilePath=Dockerfile, watchPatterns=['apps/api/**']. Build/health config in apps/api/railway.json; Root Directory is service-level and cannot live there. Manual fallback if ever needed: `railway up apps/api --path-as-root --service api --detach`. DB work: `railway ssh --service api "uv run python -m ..."`. VERIFY A DEPLOY by its `status` field — /health, existing log lines and the container's contents all answer for the old build; a failed deploy and an absent one look identical from outside. GraphQL: backboard.railway.com/graphql/v2, CLI token from ~/.railway/config.json, MUST send a User-Agent header or Cloudflare 403s (1010). serviceInstance(environmentId, serviceId) has rootDirectory/builder/dockerfilePath/watchPatterns; service(id).deployments has status + meta.
deploy.logging: Root logging is configured in create_app from BRANDCORTEX_LOG_LEVEL. Before that, uvicorn owned its loggers and root stayed at default, so brandcortex.* INFO never reached Railway — a refusal was visible only because WARNING clears the bar. Railway shows all stderr as severity=error.
